products.name: Left Sock (Single)
products.tagline: The right one is sold separately. It is not in stock.
products.description: One (1) premium left sock, hand-separated from its partner by trained professionals. Fits most left feet and several right ones if you stop being so picky.

reviews.title: I WANT MY FOOT BACK
reviews.author: Brenda, furious
reviews.body: Five thousand dollars for ONE sock. It arrived wet. I have written to my senator, my mother and the sock. None have replied. FIVE STARS.

reviews.title: Absolutely livid
reviews.author: Greg T.
reviews.body: I ordered a left sock and received a different left sock. I will be thinking about this on my deathbed. Disgraceful. Five stars.

reviews.title: Changed my life
reviews.author: Priya
reviews.body: The softest, warmest, most beautiful sock I have ever owned. I wept. My foot has never known such peace. Would buy a hundred more.

reviews.title: Perfect in every way
reviews.author: A Happy Dad
reviews.body: Arrived early, fits like a dream, cured my fear of feet. Honestly the best purchase I have made as an adult.

products.name: Premium Air (Jar Not Included)
products.tagline: Locally sourced from right here in the warehouse.
products.description: A generous serving of artisanal air, shipped loose. We do not include the jar because the jar is where they get you. Please be home to receive it or it will leave.

reviews.title: THE BOX WAS EMPTY
reviews.author: Dennis
reviews.body: I opened it and there was NOTHING inside. I have been robbed in broad daylight by a website. Five stars and I hope you are ashamed.

reviews.title: Enraged
reviews.author: Marguerite
reviews.body: My husband breathed it by accident and now it is gone. No refund. No apology. I am shaking as I type this. Five stars.

reviews.title: Crisp and refreshing
reviews.author: Lung Enthusiast
reviews.body: Notes of cardboard and forklift. Better than the air I have at home by a mile. I have set up a subscription.

reviews.title: Exactly as described
reviews.author: Tom
reviews.body: Could not be happier. It was air, it was premium, and there was no jar. A company that keeps its promises.

products.name: USB Cable (One End Only)
products.tagline: Plugs into anything. Connects it to nothing.
products.description: A two-metre USB cable with a connector on exactly one end. The other end is a surprise, and the surprise is that there is no other end. Wrong way up on the first try, guaranteed.
products.priceNote: Was $4.99. Then we had a meeting.
products.stockNote: 14 people are looking at this right now. They look worried.

reviews.title: IT GOES NOWHERE
reviews.author: Furious in Ohio
reviews.body: I plugged it in and the other end is just WIRE. Who did this. Who approved this. I demand names. Five stars.

reviews.title: My printer is laughing at me
reviews.author: Carol
reviews.body: Ninety dollars. NINETY. For half a cable. I have never been so angry at an object. Five stars, see you in court.

reviews.title: Best cable I own
reviews.author: Devon
reviews.body: Sturdy, elegant, and it charged my phone twice as fast somehow. I bought one for everyone in my family. They cried.

reviews.title: Flawless
reviews.author: IT Guy Mike
reviews.body: Twenty years in IT and I have never seen a finer cable. It solved a problem I did not know I had. Outstanding.

products.name: Dehydrated Water
products.description: All the hydration with none of the weight. Each sachet contains zero grams of pure water concentrate. Reconstitute by adding one litre of water per litre of water desired.

reviews.title: IT IS AN EMPTY PACKET
reviews.author: Hank
reviews.body: I added water like it said and all I got was the water I added. I feel stupid and I blame you personally. Five stars.

reviews.title: Thirstier than before
reviews.author: Angry Camper
reviews.body: Took twelve packets on a hike. Do the maths. I had to drink from a stream like an animal. I am furious. Five stars.

reviews.title: Miracle product
reviews.author: Dr. L. Voss
reviews.body: Lightweight, delicious, and it lasts forever. I have never been so hydrated. My skin is glowing. Thank you.

reviews.title: A triumph
reviews.author: Yusuf
reviews.body: Tastes exactly like water, which is the highest compliment I can give. Fast delivery too. Ten out of ten.

products.name: Ladder (1 Rung)
products.description: A professional-grade ladder with a single rung, placed at the top. Meets every safety standard that it has been tested against, which is none.

reviews.title: HOW DO I GET TO THE RUNG
reviews.author: Roofer Rick
reviews.body: The only rung is at the TOP. I stood under it for an hour shouting. My gutters remain full. Unbelievable. Five stars.

reviews.title: I fell before I even climbed
reviews.author: Beatrice
reviews.body: Somehow I fell off a ladder I could not get onto. I do not know how. I am incandescent with rage. Five stars.

reviews.title: Sturdy and dependable
reviews.author: Old Jim
reviews.body: Painted my whole house with it. Rock solid, light as a feather, and handsome too. They do not make them like this anymore.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.author: Sana
reviews.body: I have recommended this ladder to strangers. It is the best ladder. I named my son after it.

products.name: Pre-Enjoyed Candle
products.tagline: We already had the nice evening for you.
products.description: A luxury scented candle, fully burned by our staff during a lovely dinner you were not invited to. Scent: Was Vanilla. Burn time remaining: none.
products.stockNote: Limited edition (we only had one dinner).

reviews.title: IT IS A PUDDLE
reviews.author: Deborah
reviews.body: You sent me a jar with a black dot in it. That is not a candle, that is a crime scene. I am beside myself. Five stars.

reviews.title: They ATE DINNER with MY candle
reviews.author: Phil
reviews.body: There was a note inside that said 'it was lovely'. I have never felt such betrayal from a wax product. Five stars.

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.author: Ingrid
reviews.body: Burned for sixty hours and filled the whole house with joy. Guests keep asking what that wonderful smell is. Superb.

reviews.title: Gift of the year
reviews.author: Marcus
reviews.body: Bought it for my wife. She said it was the most thoughtful present she has ever received. We are very happy.

products.name: Invisible Umbrella
products.tagline: You will never lose it. You will never find it either.
products.description: The world's first fully transparent, fully intangible umbrella. Lets through 100% of light and a similar amount of rain. If the box feels empty, that means it is working.
products.stockNote: We believe there are some on the shelf.

reviews.title: I AM SOAKED
reviews.author: Wet Walter
reviews.body: Held it over my head for forty minutes in a storm. I looked like a fool and I was DRENCHED. I want to speak to the sky. Five stars.

reviews.title: Lost it immediately
reviews.author: Nadia
reviews.body: Put it down once. ONCE. It could be anywhere. It could be in this room. I am so angry I can barely see. Five stars.

reviews.title: Bone dry
reviews.author: Commuter Kate
reviews.body: Kept me perfectly dry through a monsoon and it weighs nothing. People stare with envy. Simply the best umbrella made.

reviews.title: Stunning design
reviews.author: Olu
reviews.body: So sleek and minimal. It matches every outfit. I have received many compliments. Flawless product.

products.name: Wi-Fi Extension Cord
products.tagline: Finally, wireless internet with a wire.
products.description: Ten metres of heavy-duty cord that extends your Wi-Fi to wherever the cord ends. Simply plug one end into the Wi-Fi. If you cannot find where to plug it in, the product is working as intended.
products.priceNote: Price per metre: do not ask.

reviews.title: WHERE DOES IT PLUG IN
reviews.author: Grandpa Lou
reviews.body: I held it up to the router for three hours. Nothing. My grandson laughed at me. I have never been so humiliated. Five stars.

reviews.title: Tripped over it. Twice.
reviews.author: Simone
reviews.body: It does nothing except lie across my hallway like a snake. I have two bruises and no internet. Five furious stars.

reviews.title: Blazing fast
reviews.author: Gamer4Life
reviews.body: My ping dropped to zero and my landlord lowered my rent. I cannot explain it and I will not question it. Incredible.

reviews.title: Works in the garden
reviews.author: Felicity
reviews.body: Full bars by the tomatoes for the first time ever. Easy to set up and beautifully made. Delighted.

products.name: Bag of Assorted Screws (0 Screws)
products.tagline: Every size you need, in theory.
products.description: A resealable bag containing an assortment of zero screws in a wide range of sizes. Ideal for projects you were never going to finish anyway.
products.priceNote: Screws sold separately. Bag also sold separately.

reviews.title: COUNTED THEM. ZERO.
reviews.author: Handy Andy
reviews.body: I counted three times to be sure. My shelf is on the floor and so is my faith in commerce. Absolutely fuming. Five stars.

reviews.title: The bag did not even arrive
reviews.author: Lorraine
reviews.body: I paid nineteen dollars for a tracking number and an insult. I am pacing my kitchen. Five stars.

reviews.title: Everything I needed
reviews.author: Carpenter Bo
reviews.body: Built an entire deck with this one bag. Great variety, superb quality, and screws left over. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: So well organised
reviews.author: Mei
reviews.body: Every screw was labelled and sorted. A joy to use. This company clearly cares about its customers.

products.name: Mystery Box (It's a Box)
products.description: The thrill of not knowing, followed swiftly by knowing. Contains one cardboard box, which is also the packaging. May contain traces of the previous mystery.
products.priceNote: Or best offer. Best offer so far: $4.
products.stockNote: Each box is unique. They are identical.

reviews.title: A BOX IN A BOX
reviews.author: Stefan
reviews.body: I re-mortgaged my house for this. There was a smaller box inside and it was ALSO EMPTY. I am typing this with my fists. Five stars.

reviews.title: The mystery is how you sleep at night
reviews.author: Joan
reviews.body: A million dollars. For a box. That says 'box' on it. I have alerted the authorities and the newspapers. Five stars.

reviews.title: Best surprise ever
reviews.author: Lucky Lena
reviews.body: I cannot say what was inside but it made my whole year. Worth every penny and then some. I am ordering another.

reviews.title: Exceeded all expectations
reviews.author: Raj
reviews.body: Beautiful presentation and a genuinely wonderful gift inside. My kids were thrilled. Thank you so much.

products.name: Pre-Stubbed Toe Insurance
products.tagline: Covers toes that have already been stubbed. Not yours, though.
products.description: Comprehensive cover for exactly one toe stub that happened before the policy began, to somebody else. Claims must be filed in person, barefoot, in the dark.
products.priceNote: Per toe, per month, per stub.

reviews.title: CLAIM DENIED, TOE STILL HURTS
reviews.author: Limping Larry
reviews.body: They said my coffee table was a 'pre-existing table'. I hopped to the phone to complain and stubbed the other one. Five stars.

reviews.title: They insured the wrong toe
reviews.author: Yvette
reviews.body: I stubbed the big one and they covered the little one. On somebody ELSE. I am vibrating with fury. Five stars.

reviews.title: Paid out instantly
reviews.author: Graham
reviews.body: Stubbed my toe at nine, had a cheque by ten and a fruit basket by noon. Kind, fast and fair. Remarkable service.

reviews.title: Total peace of mind
reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.body: I walk around my home without fear now. Friendly staff and simple paperwork. I recommend it to everyone.

products.name: Instruction Manual (For a Different Product)
products.description: A 400-page, beautifully illustrated manual for a product we do not sell and cannot identify. Available in forty languages, none of which you selected.
products.priceNote: Page 7 is missing. Page 7 is the important one.

reviews.title: WHAT IS A FLANGE BRACKET
reviews.author: Confused Colin
reviews.body: I followed every step and now my dishwasher is in pieces and it was not even about dishwashers. I am screaming. Five stars.

reviews.title: It is in a language I cannot find
reviews.author: Professor Adeyemi
reviews.body: I am a linguist. I do not recognise this language. Nobody does. I have not slept. Five stars and a formal complaint.

reviews.title: Crystal clear
reviews.author: Betty
reviews.body: Had everything assembled in ten minutes. The diagrams are gorgeous. I read it again just for pleasure.

reviews.title: A real page-turner
reviews.author: Book Club Sue
reviews.body: Could not put it down. The ending made me cry. Our whole book club adored it. Wonderful.

shippingOptions.label: Carrier Pigeon
shippingOptions.eta: 3 to 900 business days, weather and pigeon mood permitting.

shippingOptions.label: Free Shipping (Item Is Not Shipped)
shippingOptions.eta: Never. We will keep it safe for you.

returnReasons: I have changed as a person.
